fusions.name: Mouthful of Sea
fusions.desc: Gulps at every enemy within 2.5 tiles, which deals 7 damage and restores 4 health to you. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Clean Plate
fusions.desc: A lunging bite that deals 20 damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one. It heals you for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Blubber Rations
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and restores 8 health to you.

fusions.name: Larder Within
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
